reviews.body: Thanks! Non-2xx responses, 3xx included, now raise a `ToolError`, which keeps the #1885 host check from being bypassed through a redirect. I pushed one change: the message is now `METHOD path failed with HTTP code`, plus the body when there is one, instead of the resolved URL, so a credential in the server URL isn't echoed to the model. #1971 does the same in TypeScript.
